meanEn.text: a person belonging to the worldwide group claiming descent from Jacob (or converted to it) and connected by cultural or religious ties

622694.mnemonic: "jew"的含义是“犹太人”，在英语中通常指犹太民族成员，例如:"He is a Jew." (他是犹太人)。

sentence.cn: 犹太人用蜡烛庆祝光明节。
